stable.label: scratch-deep-world-tested
stable.note: The active runtime changed from a heightfield-first habitat to a chunked persistent 2D material volume for cave/world rendering and navigation. Previous CI no longer covers this changed runtime; fresh CI is required.

active_experience.runtime: vanilla JavaScript modules + Worker + transferred OffscreenCanvas; no third-party runtime libraries
simulation_changes: a persistent chunked 2D world volume now stores material identity, integrity, support, moisture, nutrients, temperature, water volume/velocity, oxygen, carbon dioxide and vapor
the deep volume is deterministically bound to the existing generated surface so visible geology and cave openings share world coordinates with organisms
the volume contains soil, stone, sand, clay, limestone, basalt, organic material and actual cave air cells rather than painted cave backgrounds
granular/weak material can change cell occupancy when unsupported or heavily saturated
underground water transfers conservatively through open volume cells and carries a velocity proxy
gas and heat exchange operate between connected open cells
chunks retain independent seed/LOD/active metadata and are activated around the camera and living organisms
ALife navigation uses A* over the persistent material-volume walk cells when the deep world is available instead of direct target chasing
A* cost includes solid occupancy, water, carbon dioxide and temperature hazards
default geology and cave rendering is extracted from the material occupancy into smoothed closed contours; simulation cells are not drawn as tiles

visible crawler bodies are generated from the articulated rig as continuous body envelopes, shell segmentation, tapered limb volumes, claws/feet and mandibles rather than circles placed on physics nodes
render pose smoothing remains presentation-only and never writes back into simulation state
approximations: this is a 2D material-volume simulation, not full 3D
deep liquid transport is a conservative cellular volume/momentum approximation, not Navier-Stokes/FLIP/MPM
surface ocean/river compatibility still uses the older 1D shallow-water state while mass can leak into deep openings

the older Environment module remains temporarily active for cloud compatibility and some organism atmosphere/waste behavior; deep-world gas is not yet the sole authority for every atmospheric subsystem
the A* planner can compute cave-volume routes but the current articulated crawler motor is still optimized for ground travel and cannot yet execute arbitrary vertical cave traversal
creature gait uses authored articulated stance/swing actuation rather than muscle physiology
ALife drive arbitration is not learning
smooth contour rendering is a visualization of discrete material state and does not change the simulation resolution

deep_world.truth: persistent 2D cells are simulation state; default renderer hides the grid behind extracted/smoothed contours

scratch_alife.note: Changed navigation path invalidates the previous overall CI promotion until rerun.

scratch_environment.note: Standalone cave/gas/liquid tests remain valid for environment.js, but it is now a compatibility subsystem rather than the sole active world volume.

legacy_ecosystem_stack.note: Previous V100-V110 and patch layers remain in repository files/history but are not imported by the active scratch route.

active_objective: Pass fresh fail-closed CI for the chunked deep-world runtime, then exercise the deployed iPhone build and judge world continuity, non-blocky geology, route behavior and motion stability.
next_gate: CI_PASS requires the new deep_world.test.mjs plus all existing scratch tests and FORGE fail-closed audit to pass. LIVE_TESTED/DEVICE_TESTED remain separate afterward.
invariants: No third-party runtime libraries in the active scratch engine
Active world simulation must use persistent state rather than decorative effects
Simulation cells may not be presented as visible block tiles in the default renderer
Physics nodes may not be rendered as circle-per-node creatures
Do not call the 2D material volume full 3D
Do not call cellular liquid transport CFD
Do not call authored gait muscle physiology
Do not call the ALife controller learning
Changed runtime invalidates prior overall CI promotion
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
